import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from lmfit import Model
from lmfit.models import VoigtModel, LorentzianModel, GaussianModel, PolynomialModel
df=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv')
x=df.shift_cm1.values; y=df.intensity.values
# remove single-point spikes: replace point deviating > 4 sigma from neighbours' median
from scipy.ndimage import median_filter
med=median_filter(y,size=5,mode='nearest')
resid_local=y-med
s=1.4826*np.median(np.abs(resid_local))
print('local noise sigma', s)
# list isolated points > 5 sigma with neighbours not elevated
for i in range(1,len(y)-1):
    if abs(y[i]-(y[i-1]+y[i+1])/2)>5*s and abs(y[i-1]-(y[i-2] if i>1 else y[i-1]))<3*s:
        pass
# fit region 60-1090 with 2 voigts + poly baseline
mod = VoigtModel(prefix='a_') + VoigtModel(prefix='b_') + PolynomialModel(3, prefix='p_')
pars = mod.make_params()
pars['a_center'].set(value=98.6, min=90, max=110); pars['a_amplitude'].set(value=5000, min=0); pars['a_sigma'].set(value=3, min=0.3, max=20); pars['a_gamma'].set(expr='a_sigma')
pars['b_center'].set(value=281.5, min=270, max=295); pars['b_amplitude'].set(value=800, min=0); pars['b_sigma'].set(value=3, min=0.3, max=20); pars['b_gamma'].set(expr='b_sigma')
pars['p_c0'].set(value=2500); pars['p_c1'].set(value=0); pars['p_c2'].set(value=0); pars['p_c3'].set(value=0)
res = mod.fit(y, pars, x=x)
print(res.fit_report())
r=y-res.best_fit
print('resid std', r.std(), 'chi-like', np.std(r))
np.save('C:/WINDOWS/TEMP/ramanlens-eval/resid.npy', r)
EOF

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from lmfit.models import VoigtModel, PolynomialModel
df=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv'); x=df.shift_cm1.values; y=df.intensity.values
def fit(extra_centers):
    mod = VoigtModel(prefix='a_') + VoigtModel(prefix='b_') + PolynomialModel(3, prefix='p_')
    p = mod.make_params()
    p['a_center'].set(value=98.5, min=90,max=110); p['a_amplitude'].set(value=56000,min=0); p['a_sigma'].set(value=2.2,min=0.3,max=20); p['a_gamma'].set(expr='a_sigma')
    p['b_center'].set(value=281.6, min=270,max=295); p['b_amplitude'].set(value=2500,min=0); p['b_sigma'].set(value=0.5,min=0.1,max=10); p['b_gamma'].set(expr='b_sigma')
    p['p_c0'].set(value=2260); p['p_c1'].set(value=0.87); p['p_c2'].set(value=0.002); p['p_c3'].set(value=-1.8e-6)
    for k,c in enumerate(extra_centers):
        m = VoigtModel(prefix=f'e{k}_'); mod = mod + m
        p.update(m.make_params())
        p[f'e{k}_center'].set(value=c, min=c-5, max=c+5); p[f'e{k}_amplitude'].set(value=500,min=0); p[f'e{k}_sigma'].set(value=2,min=0.3,max=10); p[f'e{k}_gamma'].set(expr=f'e{k}_sigma')
    return mod.fit(y,p,x=x)

print('base chi2', r0.chisqr, 'npar', r0.nvarys)
for c in [134,213,308,140,166]:

    e=r1.params
    print(c, 'chi2', round(r1.chisqr), 'dchi2/sig2', round((r0.chisqr-r1.chisqr)/(229**2),1), 'center',round(e['e0_center'].value,1),'fwhm',round(e['e0_fwhm'].value,1) if 'e0_fwhm' in e else '', 'amp', round(e['e0_amplitude'].value), '+-', round(e['e0_amplitude'].stderr or -1))
r=y-r0.best_fit
print('b peak', r0.params['b_center'].value, r0.params['b_sigma'].value, r0.params['b_amplitude'].value, r0.params['b_amplitude'].stderr)

def fit(extra_centers):
    mod = VoigtModel(prefix='a_') + VoigtModel(prefix='b_') + PolynomialModel(3, prefix='p_')
    p = mod.make_params()
    p['a_center'].set(value=98.5, min=90,max=110); p['a_amplitude'].set(value=56000,min=0); p['a_sigma'].set(value=2.2,min=0.3,max=20); p['a_gamma'].set(expr='a_sigma')
    p['b_center'].set(value=281.6, min=270,max=295); p['b_amplitude'].set(value=2500,min=0); p['b_sigma'].set(value=0.5,min=0.1,max=10); p['b_gamma'].set(expr='b_sigma')
    p['p_c0'].set(value=2260); p['p_c1'].set(value=0.87); p['p_c2'].set(value=0.002); p['p_c3'].set(value=-1.8e-6)
    for k,c in enumerate(extra_centers):
        m = VoigtModel(prefix=f'e{k}_'); mod = mod + m
        p.update(m.make_params())
        p[f'e{k}_center'].set(value=c, min=c-5, max=c+5); p[f'e{k}_amplitude'].set(value=500,min=0); p[f'e{k}_sigma'].set(value=2,min=0.3,max=10); p[f'e{k}_gamma'].set(expr=f'e{k}_sigma')
    return mod.fit(y,p,x=x)
r0=fit([])
print('base chi2', r0.chisqr, 'npar', r0.nvarys)
for c in [134,213,308,140,166]:
    r1=fit([c])
    e=r1.params
    print(c, 'chi2', round(r1.chisqr), 'dchi2/sig2', round((r0.chisqr-r1.chisqr)/(229**2),1), 'center',round(e['e0_center'].value,1),'fwhm',round(e['e0_fwhm'].value,1) if 'e0_fwhm' in e else '', 'amp', round(e['e0_amplitude'].value), '+-', round(e['e0_amplitude'].stderr or -1))
r=y-r0.best_fit
print('b peak', r0.params['b_center'].value, r0.params['b_sigma'].value, r0.params['b_amplitude'].value, r0.params['b_amplitude'].stderr)
